headline: US-Iran ceasefire deal hangs in the balance as Israel, Lebanon slated for rare Washington talks
summary: Iran has reportedly attacked and seized ships in the Strait of Hormuz while the US maintains a blockade of Iranian ports despite a ceasefire extension. Israel and Lebanon are set to hold talks in Washington.
why: The US-Iran conflict affects global oil supply, shipping routes and risk sentiment, which are key drivers for energy and equity markets.
why_moved: Reported ship attacks and seizures in the Strait of Hormuz, together with a continued US blockade of Iranian ports, have put the ceasefire in doubt.
